headline: Easy breeding chain: Mammorest
title: Easy Mammorest Breeding Chain in Palworld | 3 Steps From Easy Pals | Palworld Breeding Guide
video_script: Get Mammorest, a huge, tanky giant, with this simple breeding chain in Palworld. Step one: breed Lovander with Robinquill to get Sweepa. Step two: breed that Sweepa with Incineram to get Sibelyx. Step three: breed Sibelyx with Wumpo, and the egg hatches into Mammorest! Every step is checked against Palworld one point zero breeding data. Put each pair on the Breeding Farm with a cake. Which Pal should I chain next? Comment below!
description: Easy 3-step Palworld 1.0 breeding chain to Mammorest: Lovander + Robinquill = Sweepa, Sweepa + Incineram = Sibelyx, Sibelyx + Wumpo = Mammorest. Each step verified on PalBreedCalc and with the breeding formula from PinDrop's combi ranks.
